name: Shenzhen Center Power Tech. Co., Ltd
summary: Shenzhen Center Power Tech. Co., Ltd research, develops, produces, and sells valve-regulated sealed lead-acid batteries, lithium-ion batteries, and fuel cells in China. The company provides lead acid and lithium batteries, as well as hydrogen full cell. It offers lithium cobalt oxide, lithium iron phosphate, lithium manganese oxide, fuel cell systems, fuel cell stacks, and membrane electrode. The company's products are used in UPS and AIDC batteries, telecom batteries, motive power, and energy storage industries. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
